description: A place: a stable name for a web tile that travellers can go to, whatever version of the tile is current. Ways between tiles (thunderbird.cafe, v 1): a tile lists its exits and entrances in its /ways.json; each exit names a signpost (cafe.thunderbird.way.signpost) that says where it leads; signposts point at places. Republishing a tile updates its place, so nothing pointing at the place has to change.

main.description: The record key is the tile's short id, chosen once and never reused (e.g. "maze").

cid.description: That record's exact version, so a host opens exactly what was meant.

name.description: A name to show on cards.
